name: Haruka Nakamiya
source:
A girl who was born and raised in this town all her life. A kind face who reached out to Riku on his first day of school. Will she be different from the other friends he has met and been separated from throughout his life?

[From [url=http://homeward.renai.us/]official site[/url]]
